verdicts.title: The $f$--vector of the clique complex of chordal graphs and Betti numbers of edge ideals of uniform hypergraphs
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We describe the Betti numbers of the edge ideals $I(G)$ of uniform hypergraphs $G$ such that $I(G)$ has linear graded free resolution. We give an algebraic equation system and some inequalities for the components of the $f$--vector of the clique complex of an arbitrary chordal graph. Finally we present an explicit formula for the multiplicity of the Stanley-Reisner ring of the edge ideals of any chordal graph.

verdicts.title: Intermediate Ricci curvatures and Gromov's Betti number bound
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We consider intermediate Ricci curvatures $Ric_k$ on a closed Riemannian manifold $M^n$. These interpolate between the Ricci curvature when $k=n-1$ and the sectional curvature when $k=1$. By establishing a surgery result for Riemannian metrics with $Ric_k>0$, we show that Gromov's upper Betti number bound for sectional curvature bounded below fails to hold for $Ric_k>0$ when $\lfloor n/2 \rfloor+2 \le k \le n-1$. This was previously known only in the case of positive Ricci curvature.
